claim: All defects found in this audit are handled. Not a claim that no bugs remain.

bugs.title: Two competing reward implementations; internal one used the superseded provisional formula
bugs.discovered_by: 11 published reward vectors run against scoring/reward.py
bugs.root_cause: Phase 6 provisional reward module never retired after the official scorer landed in RC-004; no test pinned the two together
bugs.impact: All internal reward-derived artifacts published numbers the jury would not reproduce; negative rewards impossible; empty-truth P/R wrong

bugs.title: Cursor tokens unusable for ~6.5% of offsets (delimiter byte inside random HMAC signature)
bugs.discovered_by: walking official fixture L (214-row ledger) at limit=50
bugs.root_cause: token = raw || b'.' || sig, split with rsplit(b'.',1); ~6.5% of 16-byte signatures contain 0x2E
bugs.impact: Rows 200-213 of the L fixture ledger unreachable; official C05 would fail
bugs.artifact_consequence: trajectories.jsonl regenerated; verified only cursor tokens changed, metrics identical

bugs.title: Trailing base64 garbage accepted: token + 'x' decoded to original bytes and passed HMAC check
bugs.discovered_by: existing tamper test failing once BUG-TL-0002 was fixed
bugs.root_cause: decode verified the HMAC of decoded bytes but never that the token was their canonical encoding
bugs.impact: Tamper evidence was weaker than documented; the old test passed by luck

bugs.title: Official C05 test walked only invoices, missing the table that needs a fourth page
bugs.root_cause: test mirrored the wording 'three pages' and stopped at the minimum instead of checking every table
bugs.impact: A P0 shipping defect was invisible to the official suite
